prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Choose Your Pet Path", "body": "Select a ready-made digital pet or create a custom companion from your photos."}}
1: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in after adoption certificate completion: Shift the sign-in step to immediately follow the adoption certificate stage, securing user pet metadata right after creation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"], "sign_in": {"headline": "Save Your Companion to Account", "body": "Sign in now to lock in your official adoption certificate and sync your pet across devices."}}

   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_guide", "home_intro"], "new_desktop_guide": {"headline": "Your Pet Lives On Your Desktop", "body": "Drag your pet anywhere on your screen. Right-click your pet to access settings, hide, or interact.", "layout": "centered"}}

   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Upload Photo or Choose a Template", "body": "Upload your photo or pick one of our starter templates to generate your custom pet.", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "style": "playful", "action": "choose", "label": "Use Starter Template"}]}}

   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Official Adoption Certificate", "body": "Finalize your pet adoption to receive your official certificate and 100 bonus pet treats!", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "100 Bonus Treats Included", "style": "highlight"}]}}

   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Your Pet is Ready!", "body": "Click below to place your new pet directly onto your desktop workspace.", "button_label": "Summon Pet to Desktop"}}
8: [choose_path, hint] Onboarding duration expectation hint on story screen: Add a hint banner to the story screen informing users that setup takes under 2 minutes.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Welcome to Desktop Pets", "body": "Your new desktop friend is just a few steps away.", "hint": "Onboarding takes about 2 minutes. Pick your favorite companion next!"}}

   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "body": "Feel free to minimize this window. We will send a desktop notification when your pet is ready!", "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Desktop notification enabled when rendering finishes.", "style": "subtle"}]}}

Reordering sign-in step within onboarding is explicitly permitted.
Adding a new desktop guide screen within onboarding is allowed.
Adding starter template choices to upload_photos screen is allowed.
Adding account restoration hint text on sign-in screen is allowed.
Adding progress indicator and notifications to waiting screen is allowed.
Onboarding copy mentions gifts or free extras (100 bonus treats).
Redesigning home intro layout is allowed within onboarding.
Adding onboarding duration hint to story screen is allowed.
Configuring ready notifications on waiting screen is allowed.
